n434cc7a532.headline: US stocks end down on economic worry; oil up on Middle East tensions
n434cc7a532.summary: U.S. stocks posted modest losses and the dollar strengthened as investors weighed solid data against trade cautions from central bank leaders. Oil rose on geopolitical tensions, including reports of Israeli airstrikes on Gaza.
n434cc7a532.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large U.S.-listed companies and is a standard gauge of the U.S. equity market. Crude oil prices are sensitive to supply risks in the Middle East, a major producing region.
n434cc7a532.why_moved: Investors weighed solid U.S. jobless-claims data against cautious comments on trade from central bank leaders. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Ukraine lifted oil prices.

n3c7f9d85dd.headline: World Bank: 2025 Begins Strong for Kazakh Economy
n3c7f9d85dd.summary: The World Bank said the Kazakh economy began 2025 strongly, according to The Astana Times.
n3c7f9d85dd.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose country assessments inform investor views on emerging economies. Kazakhstan is a major oil and metals producer.

nc5956a238f.headline: Hunting for an affordable house? You might want to consider these states
nc5956a238f.summary: A Redfin analysis ranked US states by the median price homes sold for in March, identifying those with the most affordable properties.
nc5956a238f.why: Redfin is a US real estate brokerage that publishes housing market data, and home affordability shapes mortgage demand, household spending and residential construction activity.

n836354fbf3.headline: Watchdog unveils proposal to end supermarket price-gouging, shrinkflation
n836354fbf3.summary: Australia's competition watchdog, the ACCC, has released its final supermarket inquiry report and unveiled a proposal to end price gouging and shrinkflation.
n836354fbf3.why: The ACCC is Australia's competition regulator, and its supermarket measures can change pricing practices at the two dominant grocery chains and affect retail margins.

nf1fde5a8b0.headline: Australia's Domain's largest shareholder in talks to sell stake in $1.7 billion takeover
nf1fde5a8b0.summary: Nine Entertainment confirmed it is in talks to sell its 60% stake in Domain as part of a A$2.65 billion takeover by a US firm. The deal is valued at about $1.7 billion.
nf1fde5a8b0.why: Domain is an Australian property listings group, and large takeovers reshape ownership and valuation of listed property-technology companies on the ASX.

n9b938b75f8.headline: Pakistan materialises $6bn from creditors, $1.2bn Saudi oil facility to resume this month
n9b938b75f8.summary: Pakistan will start receiving $100m monthly from March and expects $4.4bn in foreign loans from March to June. Government also attracted $1.3bn through Naya Pakistan Certificates.
n9b938b75f8.why: External financing and oil-import facilities determine Pakistan's foreign reserves, balance of payments and its sovereign credit risk.

nba7404b758.headline: France to launch €450m defence fund amid growing security concerns
nba7404b758.summary: France will launch a €450m defence fund, with French citizens able to invest for the long term. The government faces challenges in collecting the funds, according to the report.
nba7404b758.why: Defence investment vehicles channel private capital into European rearmament, affecting defence contractors and French public finances.

n23c0fe6dbd.headline: China Kills A River In Foreign Country With Acidic Waste Spill, Leaving Millions In Emergency
n23c0fe6dbd.summary: A large acid leak from a Chinese-run mine in Zambia contaminated the country's most important waterway, threatening the livelihoods and health of millions, according to reports.
n23c0fe6dbd.why: Mining operations in Africa are a major source of copper and other metals, and environmental incidents can bring regulatory action, costs and reputational risk.

n0630927851.headline: Australia's supermarkets grew profit margins as living costs soared, says regulator
n0630927851.summary: Australia's dominant supermarket chains benefited from wider profit margins as shelf prices rose rapidly, the competition regulator said in a new report. The report was released on Thursday.
n0630927851.why: Woolworths and Coles dominate Australian grocery retail, so their margins and pricing draw regulatory scrutiny. Regulatory action can affect earnings and sector sentiment.

n07bc5a466b.headline: Finance minister wants to table entire tax bill in Seimas in April
n07bc5a466b.summary: Finance Minister Rimantas Šadžius expects to present the entire package of proposed tax changes in the Seimas as soon as April. The package covers planned tax changes.
n07bc5a466b.why: Tax changes in Lithuania affect businesses, household spending and public finances, which matter for investors in the Baltic economy.

na6115d4542.headline: Temu Owner PDD Posts Slowest Revenue Growth Since Early 2022
na6115d4542.summary: The owner of Temu reported slower quarterly profit and revenue growth. The results cap a turbulent year as the e-commerce group faced stiff competition at home.
na6115d4542.why: PDD Holdings owns the Temu and Pinduoduo platforms, and its growth trends are closely watched as a gauge of Chinese and global e-commerce demand.
na6115d4542.why_moved: The company reported slower quarterly profit and revenue growth, with competition at home described as stiff.

nf8ba020325.headline: Chronic patients get most relief in medicine cost cut
nf8ba020325.summary: Patients could save almost $7 on each prescription as the government promises to make medicines cheaper. The measure is set to benefit chronic-illness patients most.
nf8ba020325.why: Changes to prescription pricing affect pharmaceutical revenues and government health spending in Australia.

nb1efea1794.headline: Gold pauses for breath after record run on safe-haven demand
nb1efea1794.summary: Gold prices eased after hitting a record high of $3,057.21 an ounce, with spot gold down 0.3% at $3,038.50 on profit-taking. Expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts supported the outlook.
nb1efea1794.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that tends to benefit from lower interest rates and geopolitical uncertainty. Its price is set in global wholesale markets quoted in US dollars.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold hit a record high before easing on profit-taking, while retaining a bullish outlook.

n901580c33b.headline: Hellenic Bank merger with Eurobank enters final phase
n901580c33b.summary: Hellenic Bank is preparing a dual merger that will combine its banking operations with Eurobank and its insurance division with CNP Cyprus Insurance Holdings. The process is in its final phase, according to a briefing with journalists.
n901580c33b.why: Hellenic Bank is a Cypriot lender, and Eurobank is a Greek banking group, so the deal reshapes ownership and consolidation in Cyprus's banking and insurance sectors.

impacts.name: Eurobank
impacts.why: Eurobank is the named partner absorbing Hellenic Bank's banking business.

n1234cc8b24.headline: Gulf Keystone shares rise on Full-Year Results | Iraq Business News
n1234cc8b24.summary: Gulf Keystone Petroleum reported its results for the year ended 31 December 2024 and its shares traded up more than two percent at lunchtime. The CEO cited strong operational and financial delivery.
n1234cc8b24.why: Gulf Keystone is an oil producer with operations in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, listed in London.

sources.name: Iraq Business News | All the latest business news from Iraq

n2504d02f01.headline: Malaysia and Indonesia plan to store East Asia’s emissions
n2504d02f01.summary: Malaysia and Indonesia plan to store carbon emissions from East Asia. Japan and South Korea have signed agreements to export their emissions to Malaysia and Indonesia.
n2504d02f01.why: Carbon capture and storage is an emerging industry in which storage services can generate revenue and support emissions-reduction targets.

nf744285d47.headline: Dollar rises as Fed sees no rush to cut rates
nf744285d47.summary: The dollar rose broadly after the Federal Reserve indicated it was in no rush to cut rates further this year due to uncertainty around U.S. tariffs. The Swiss National Bank cut its policy rate to 0.25%.
nf744285d47.why: The U.S. dollar is the world's main reserve currency, so Federal Reserve policy shapes global borrowing costs, capital flows and currency values.

impacts.name: Swiss franc
impacts.why: The article says the franc weakened after the Swiss National Bank cut its policy rate to 0.25%.

nf744285d47.why_moved: The Fed signalled no rush to cut rates further, which the article links to uncertainty around U.S. tariffs, lifting the dollar. The Swiss National Bank's rate cut weakened the franc.

n4d2399dec2.headline: U.S. jury orders Amsterdam-based Greenpeace to pay millions over Dakota pipeline protest
n4d2399dec2.summary: A North Dakota jury ruled that Greenpeace must pay damages to an oil pipeline owner for delaying construction through a reservation. Total damages exceed $660 million, with the Amsterdam-based branch liable for part.
n4d2399dec2.why: Greenpeace is a campaigning non-profit, and large damage awards in energy-infrastructure disputes can affect litigation risk for activism and pipeline developers.

n55bb05a03b.headline: Millions set for £1,400 pay rise from next month - what to know
n55bb05a03b.summary: Millions of UK workers are set for a pay rise from next month under the National Minimum Wage, which sets the minimum hourly pay employers must provide.
n55bb05a03b.why: Minimum wage increases raise employers' labour costs, particularly for retail, hospitality and care businesses with large low-paid workforces.

n9cba39f53a.headline: Explained: How WazirX Plans To Pay Back Users
n9cba39f53a.summary: WazirX has explained how it plans to pay back users following a July 2024 cyberattack in which the exchange lost over $230 million. The plan is a key step in addressing customer losses.
n9cba39f53a.why: WazirX is an Indian cryptocurrency exchange, and its customer repayments affect investor confidence in local crypto platforms.

nf1d2765898.headline: Financial stocks push Australian market to 11-day high
nf1d2765898.summary: Australian shares bounced back from several days of market turbulence. Rallies in financial, IT and real estate stocks led the advance to an 11-day high.
nf1d2765898.why: The ASX 200 is Australia's benchmark equity index, and financial stocks such as the major banks make up a large share of it.

na4118f7f44.headline: Will Australia's new ban on foreign home buyers make a difference?
na4118f7f44.summary: The Australian government has tightened rules on foreign home purchases with a new ban. PropTrack commented on whether the measure will make a difference to the housing market.
na4118f7f44.why: Foreign buyer restrictions influence housing demand and prices, which feed into the banking, construction and property sectors.

n982972c220.headline: 10 states where car loan debt is falling the most
n982972c220.summary: Falling car loan debt in ten US states could signal consumers scaling back purchases because of rising car prices, one analyst said.
n982972c220.why: Auto loans are a major category of consumer credit, so changes in balances offer a read on household spending.

n51b102f4b8.headline: U.S. tariffs disrupt the tech industry: 8 vital things you need to know
n51b102f4b8.summary: Costs in the tech industry are rising rapidly because of US tariffs and may keep rising, with further changes to the industry expected, according to PCWorld.
n51b102f4b8.why: Tariffs on imported components raise hardware costs for electronics makers and the retailers that sell their products.

n39910cb248.headline: Nestle's Chocolate Chief Sees Demand Remaining High Despite Cocoa Price Surge, Valor Says
n39910cb248.summary: Nestle's global head of chocolate, Liberato Milo, said the sharp rise in cocoa bean prices over the past two years has not dented chocolate demand. He made the comments in an interview with Brazilian media outlet Valor.
n39910cb248.why: Nestle is one of the world's largest food companies, and cocoa is a key input cost for its confectionery business.

impacts.name: Nestle
impacts.why: The chocolate chief's comments relate to how Nestle's demand is holding up despite higher cocoa costs.

n4655cd28c7.headline: China's HBIS collaborates with Vale to advance steel decarbonisation
n4655cd28c7.summary: Chinese steelmaker HBIS signed a memorandum of understanding with iron ore miner Vale to promote decarbonisation in the steel value chain. Both companies announced the agreement on Thursday.
n4655cd28c7.why: Vale is one of the world's largest iron ore producers, and steel decarbonisation efforts can affect long-term demand for different grades of iron ore.

impacts.why: The memorandum sets out a decarbonisation partnership between Vale and HBIS in the steel value chain.

n5bae8ac3c4.headline: Beacon Roofing agrees to $11 billion QXO buyout, ending takeover battle
n5bae8ac3c4.summary: Beacon Roofing Supply has agreed to an $11 billion buyout offer from billionaire Brad Jacobs. The agreement ends a takeover battle for the roofing distributor.
n5bae8ac3c4.why: Beacon Roofing Supply is a large US distributor of roofing materials, so its ownership change affects a major building-supply player.

n557a3242bc.headline: ChatGPT Under Fire for Spreading Defamatory Personal Info in EU
n557a3242bc.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT faces fresh challenges in Europe after it was found generating defamatory information about users.
n557a3242bc.why: OpenAI develops ChatGPT, and European data protection and AI rules can impose compliance costs and fines on AI services.

n736ce3f467.headline: As the Fed leaves interest rates unchanged, some metro Detroiters worry about their economic future
n736ce3f467.summary: The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged, and new Fed revelations are deepening concerns about the economy and higher prices, according to Detroit residents interviewed by WXYZ.
n736ce3f467.why: The Federal Reserve sets the US federal funds rate, which influences borrowing costs, bond yields and the dollar across global markets.

n8eb1af5166.headline: Sri Lanka GSP+ preference erosion ‘worrying’: IPS
n8eb1af5166.summary: Colombo think tank IPS said erosion of the EU's GSP+ trade preferences is worrying for Sri Lanka amid trade uncertainty. US President Trump is pursuing reciprocal tariffs.
n8eb1af5166.why: GSP+ gives eligible developing countries reduced or zero EU tariffs, which matters for exporters such as Sri Lanka's apparel sector.

ne9583344c6.headline: Mixed Sentiment Amidst Fed's Guidance
ne9583344c6.summary: Market sentiment remained mixed as investors assimilated the Federal Reserve's latest guidance on interest rates and its outlook for the economy.
ne9583344c6.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, equity valuations and the dollar across global markets.

ne9bf639ca3.headline: USD/JPY Analysis: Dollar Weakens After Fed Decision
ne9bf639ca3.summary: The dollar weakened against the yen after the Fed decision, while the Bank of Japan left rates unchanged and flagged uncertainty about Japan's economy and a changing trade environment.
ne9bf639ca3.why: The yen-dollar exchange rate is driven by the policy divergence between the Bank of Japan and the Federal Reserve, and is closely watched by global investors.
ne9bf639ca3.why_moved: The dollar weakened after the Fed decision, while the Bank of Japan kept rates unchanged and cited trade-related uncertainty.

ne48b6574ab.headline: RWE Stock Dips On Weak FY24 Adj. EBITDA, Outlook Warning, Cuts In Investments
ne48b6574ab.summary: RWE shares were down around 3% in German trading after the utility warned on weak adjusted EBITDA for fiscal 2025 following lower adjusted fiscal 2024 results. Investments are also being cut.
ne48b6574ab.why: RWE is a major German electric utility with large renewable and conventional power operations. Its earnings guidance affects European utility sector sentiment.

nabc5dd33df.headline: SSC warns of fake securities business scams targeting investors
nabc5dd33df.summary: The State Securities Commission of Vietnam warned on March 19 that firms posing as authorised securities companies are tricking investors into making deposits into accounts.
nabc5dd33df.why: The State Securities Commission regulates Vietnam's securities market, and fraud involving fake brokers erodes investor confidence and market integrity.

na555db038d.headline: PSX reaches historic high as Pakistan closes in on new IMF loan tranche
na555db038d.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange reached an all-time high on Thursday as Pakistan and the IMF moved closer to agreeing a new loan tranche.
na555db038d.why: The IMF loan programme supports Pakistan's external finances, and its approval is closely watched by foreign and local investors.
na555db038d.why_moved: Progress toward a new IMF loan tranche lifted sentiment, pushing the exchange to an all-time high.

nd3b5181949.headline: South Korea's total debt hits record high of over $4.27 trillion
nd3b5181949.summary: Combined debt of the government, companies and households in South Korea reached an all-time high amid weak domestic demand and falling revenues.
nd3b5181949.why: Rising debt levels can constrain growth and raise financial stability concerns for lenders and investors.

n5e14747204.headline: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K Amid Trump’s Canada Tariffs
n5e14747204.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $80,000 on March 11, 2025, reversing a climb past $82,000 after Trump's tariffs on Canadian imports rattled financial markets. A weaker US dollar and mixed job openings were overshadowed.
n5e14747204.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and often trades on macroeconomic risk sentiment as well as crypto-specific news. Its price swings are widely watched by investors in digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The price fell below $80,000 as macroeconomic uncertainty from tariffs weighed on risk assets.

n5e14747204.why_moved: Bitcoin's decline was driven by macroeconomic uncertainty from Trump's tariffs on Canadian imports rather than crypto-specific factors. The tariff news overshadowed a weaker US dollar and mixed job openings data.

n777168c61d.headline: The Stock Exchange of Thailand and DSI Collaborate to Restore Confidence in the Thai Capital Market
n777168c61d.summary: The Stock Exchange of Thailand and the Department of Special Investigation met with the Prime Minister to report progress and implement measures to restore market confidence.
n777168c61d.why: Restoring investor confidence is critical for market stability and capital inflows in Thailand's financial markets.

nd145231b03.headline: 111, Inc. Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Results
nd145231b03.summary: 111, Inc., a tech-enabled healthcare platform, announced its financial results for Q4 and fiscal year 2024, highlighting its ongoing commitment to reshaping the healthcare value chain.
nd145231b03.why: 111, Inc. is a significant player in China's healthcare technology sector, and its financial performance reflects trends in healthtech innovation and market demand.

n13a1e1951a.headline: Zeekr Group Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Unaudited Financial Results
n13a1e1951a.summary: Zeekr Intelligent Technology Holding Limited released its unaudited financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2024.
n13a1e1951a.why: Zeekr is a key player in the electric vehicle sector, and its financial performance provides insights into the industry's growth and competitive dynamics.
